title: Leaves of Grass
author: Walt Whitman
edition_reference: Deathbed Edition (1891–92) — poetry from Project Gutenberg #1322 + 1855 Preface + A Backward Glance O'er Travel'd Roads (1888) from PG #8813 Complete Prose Works
provenance_note: Two PG sources combined: #1322 (poetry, 1892 Deathbed) + #8813 (Complete Prose Works including 1855/1872/1876 Prefaces and 'A Backward Glance'). PG #1322 alone is poetry-only; the Deathbed Edition canonically includes 'A Backward Glance' as Whitman's final retrospective afterword.
constitutional_role: American canon. A primary text of the descent — bodily, democratic, ecstatic, elegiac.
